findings.meaning: the PlayerCamera vtable slot 2 hook added in v07 never runs; the v07 fix premise was false; the camera is driven by the FirstPersonState getters only

findings.evidence: deviations of 140-178 u for 2-3 s at yaw ~130-240; rendered camera on the eye->sight line at 129.9-131.3 u from the vanilla eye (38.6,215.9,574.8); no pull at yaw ~313 (anchor 186 u away)
findings.cause: Skyrim pulls the camera toward the player head when a sphere swept from the head to the camera position meets collision: the fixed ballista base box (z up to 137.6 above the root, the player eye is ~109) lies between the eye and the sight when the turret faces away. A 12-15 u sphere first touches it at 115-127 u in the four logged cases.
findings.correction_of_v09_analysis: v09 ruled camera collision out with a wrong eye (at the crank instead of the logged player position) and with the reimported ballista collision left at z 0 (PyNifly does not parent it to the moved root).
